claims.claim: High Quality Solar Panels, Inverters, Lithium&Tubular Batteries, Charge...
claims.evidence: Generic advertising text, not tied to any specific photo or spec.

claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours
claims.evidence: The witness report identifies the item as a solar panel, not a battery; no battery is shown in either photo, so this claim does not match the photographed item.
No internals, junction box, or repair history visible in the photos.

risks.risk: Claim text describes a battery while photos show a solar panel
risks.proof: A photo of the actual item with seller confirming correct listing, plus a nameplate/wattage photo matching the panel
risks.if_unproven: treat listing as mismatched/unverified identity, price at worst case for an unbranded, unrated solar panel only

risks.proof: Close-up of nameplate or wattage sticker on panel back
risks.if_unproven: price as lowest common wattage for this panel size/type

risks.proof: Manufacture date sticker or seller-provided purchase receipt photo

risks.risk: Possible hidden cell damage, hotspots, or microcracks
risks.proof: Close-up front-face photo in bright light or an electroluminescence/thermal test clip

risks.risk: Condition of junction box and cables unknown
risks.proof: Photo of the back junction box and cable connectors
Clip of panel under sunlight with multimeter reading voltage/current
risks.if_unproven: price as non-verified output, worst case low performance

proof_requests: Clear photo of the item actually for sale matching the battery claim, or confirmation that only the solar panel is being sold
Close-up of panel nameplate showing wattage, model, and manufacturer
Photo of the back junction box and cables
Short video of panel output test with a multimeter under sunlight
Any purchase receipt or date-of-manufacture sticker
response.reason: The seller's claims describe a battery's charge life, but the witness report shows only an unbranded, unrated solar panel with no battery present, a mismatch that raises scam risk until clarified.
